description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the DHCPv4 Client component in a TR-069 device management context. It includes class declarations, constants, and data structures for managing DHCPv4 client information such as interface, DNS servers, and IP routers.

classes.name: hostIf_DHCPv4Client
classes.description: Class providing interface to access DHCPv4 client information, including methods for retrieving interface, DNS servers, and IP routers, as well as managing instances and synchronization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of hostIf_DHCPv4Client for a given device ID.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all existing instances of hostIf_DHCPv4Client.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a specific hostIf_DHCPv4Client instance.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_ClientNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of DHCPv4 client entries.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_Client_InterfaceReference
methods.description: Gets the interface reference for DHCPv4 client.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_Client_DnsServer
methods.description: Retrieves DNS server information for DHCPv4 client.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_Client_IPRouters
methods.description: Retrieves IP routers information for DHCPv4 client.

methods.name: getNotifyHash
methods.description: Returns the hash table for notification management.
